title: Focus stays on the submit button after validation fails
description: When validation fails, the error summary appears above the form without receiving focus. The user is left on the Continue button, below the new content.

relatedElements.note: Receives focus when the summary is shown.

expectedBehaviour: After failed validation, focus moves to the error summary or the first invalid field so the failure is announced.
actualBehaviour: Focus remains on the Continue button and the summary is not announced.
userImpact: Keyboard and screen-reader users may not realise validation failed and can remain at the bottom of the form.

wcag.note: The error is identified in text. Moving focus is a recommended pattern, not a separate WCAG requirement.

detection.note: Requires an interaction test that records document.activeElement after submit.

manualTests: Submit the empty form with the keyboard and check whether focus moves to the summary.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: document.activeElement is #submit-a after the error summary is shown.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps variant A errors unassociated, unfocused and linked to nothing

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
